text.arabic_uthmani: وَإِذْ قُلْنَا لَكَ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ أَحَاطَ بِٱلنَّاسِ ۚ وَمَا جَعَلْنَا ٱلرُّءْيَا ٱلَّتِىٓ أَرَيْنَٰكَ إِلَّا فِتْنَةًۭ لِّلنَّاسِ وَٱلشَّجَرَةَ ٱلْمَلْعُونَةَ فِى ٱلْقُرْءَانِ ۚ وَنُخَوِّفُهُمْ فَمَا يَزِيدُهُمْ إِلَّا طُغْيَٰنًۭا كَبِيرًۭا

words.gloss_range: connective opening that carries the prior sign-policy into a recalled divine speech scene
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens as a connective recall, carrying the sign-policy of 17:59 into the remembered speech scene. The ayah therefore begins as explanation and continuation, not as a detached statement.

topics.headline: connective recall from sign-policy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees 17:60 as a connected explanation of the sign-policy in 17:59, not an isolated new topic.
topics.reason: The opening connector and idh-frame coherently link the prior sign-policy to a recalled divine speech scene.

words.gloss_range: past temporal recall marker, with possible causal pressure, that frames the ayah as remembered divine address
words.prose: {{ar:إِذْ}} ({{tr:idh}}) supplies the past recall frame, as though the reader is asked to remember when the speech was given. A causal pressure can be felt because the encompassing claim grounds the trial, but the local frame remains temporal recall.

topics.headline: past recall frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader supplies the remembered when-frame that turns the ayah into a recalled divine communication.
topics.reason: QAC identifies a past temporal adverb connected to implied recall, matching the temporal CRITICAL rows.

topics.headline: temporal frame with causal pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can feel divine encompassing as the ground of the trial, while local grammar keeps the primary function temporal recall.
topics.reason: The causal value is possible pressure beside the selected temporal frame, not a replacement of the local recall function.

words.gloss_range: completed divine saying addressed to the Prophet, functioning as authoritative declaration rather than casual narration
words.root_gloss_range: saying, declaring, commanding, reporting, and articulate utterance; here selected as completed divine declaration to an addressee
words.prose: {{ar:قُلْنَا}} ({{tr:qulnā}}) presents completed divine speech addressed to the Prophet, with the following emphatic clause as its quoted content. The formula also gives the scene weight beside other decisive divine speech openings (17:61; 2:34).

topics.headline: completed divine speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the assurance belongs to a completed divine speech act before the ongoing warning clause.
topics.reason: The perfect 1pl form and divine subject suffix support completed divine agency.

topics.headline: authoritative declaration to an addressee
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the encompassing claim as authoritative quoted disclosure routed to the Prophet through address.
topics.reason: The lām complement and embedded emphatic clause make the speech declarative and addressed.

topics.headline: recognized divine speech formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the opening as a weighty scene-formula that also introduces decisive command scenes (17:61; 2:34).
topics.reason: The supplied inter rows cite the same wa-idh qulnā pattern at 17:61 and 2:34, and no local evidence blocks the formula comparison.

words.gloss_range: prepositional direct address to the Prophet, distinct from the later public trial directed to people
words.prose: {{ar:لَكَ}} ({{tr:laka}}) makes the Prophet the direct recipient of the disclosure before the ayah turns to the people as the trial field. Its -ka joins the later chain of personal address in your Lord and We showed you.

topics.headline: private prophetic recipient
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the assurance is first routed to the Prophet personally, not directly to the public.
topics.reason: The preposition plus 2ms suffix marks a directed addressee relation.

topics.headline: private address versus public trial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the event distributed across roles: the Prophet receives disclosure while the people become the testing field.
topics.reason: The later lām phrase for the people contrasts with this earlier lām-address.

topics.headline: repeated second-person suffix chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the Prophet through three bound relations: addressed, related to his Lord, and shown the vision.
topics.reason: The -ka suffix recurs in the addressed phrase, Lord phrase, and caused-seeing verb.

words.gloss_range: emphatic particle that opens the quoted content and marks divine encompassing as asserted certainty
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) opens the quoted content with emphasis, so divine encompassing is heard as asserted certainty. That certainty stands before the ayah describes fitna and a resistant response to warning.

topics.headline: emphatic quoted certainty
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears divine encompassing as asserted certainty inside the quotation, before trial and resistance are described.
topics.reason: The particle governs the quoted nominal clause and marks the boundary between speech frame and content.

topics.headline: emphasis before resistant response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that certainty is front-loaded before the ayah turns to people whose response to warning fails.
topics.reason: The emphatic particle coherently anticipates denial pressure without changing the local grammar.

words.gloss_range: the Prophet-addressed Lord as emphatic subject: lordly ownership, nurture, and governance focused through the suffix
words.root_gloss_range: lordship, ownership, nurture, governance, and sustaining authority; here bound to the Prophet by the possessive suffix
words.prose: {{ar:رَبَّكَ}} ({{tr:rabbaka}}) places your Lord as the emphatic subject before the encompassing verb. Lordship here carries governance, care, and authority focused through the Prophet-facing suffix, while the people form the object field of that Lordship.

topics.headline: emphatic subject under inna
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the Lord foregrounded as the emphatic subject before the encompassing verb.
topics.reason: QAC marks accusative governance by inna and the clause order foregrounds the subject.

topics.headline: Lordship bound to the Prophet
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels encompassing as lordly governance and care addressed through your Lord, not as bare impersonal power.
topics.reason: The possessive singular title and r-b-b semantic range support personal Lordship as the agent of encompassing.

topics.headline: Lord-people axis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the first axis of the ayah: your Lord faces the people, first in encompassing and then in trial.
topics.reason: The repeated people phrases keep the same human collective under the Lordship frame.

words.gloss_range: completed Form IV encompassing with bi-valency: surrounding scope and comprehensive knowledge focused on the people
words.root_gloss_range: surrounding, enclosing, protecting, and comprehensive knowledge; here selected as completed divine encompassing through bi-valency
words.prose: {{ar:أَحَاطَ}} ({{tr:ahāṭa}}) gives completed Form IV encompassing through the marked bi-construction. The word lets physical enclosure and comprehensive knowledge press together: the people are inside divine scope before their trial and overflow are narrated, in contrast to sin encompassing a person elsewhere (2:81). Its hamza onset gives the encompassing claim a sharp entry before the surrounding verb unfolds.

topics.headline: completed bi-governed encompassing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a finished divine enclosure of the people before the ayah narrates their testing and response.
topics.reason: The perfect Form IV verb governs the people through bi, supporting completed transitive encompassing.

topics.headline: enclosure and full knowledge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels a concrete surrounding perimeter together with comprehensive awareness, so no response escapes divine scope.
topics.reason: The lexical evidence supports both surrounding and comprehensive knowledge as compatible local pressures.

topics.headline: reversal of sin-enclosure pattern
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a totality contrast: here God encompasses people before transgression, while elsewhere sin encompasses the sinner (2:81).
topics.reason: The inter row gives a concrete same-verb contrast at 2:81, and it does not control the local parse.

topics.headline: abrupt hamza entry
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the encompassing claim enter sharply before the surrounding verb unfolds.
topics.reason: The sound observation is local to the surface and adds a small but distinct auditory payoff.

words.gloss_range: object-marking preposition after encompassing, preserving the image of people inside divine scope

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: later lām-governed people phrase marking the public target of trial

words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) is the hinge that marks what is encompassed. It keeps the people inside the surrounding scope, prepares the later shift to {{ar:لِلنَّاسِ}} ({{tr:li-n-nāsi}}), and can be read against Surah 17’s broader human contrast (17:100) without changing its local function.

topics.headline: bi marks encompassed object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the preposition helps make the people the content inside encompassing rather than an ordinary direct object.
topics.reason: QAC identifies bi as the object marker required with ahāṭa, preserving the enclosure relation.

topics.headline: first people-slot before target role
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the first people-slot prepare for the later shift from encompassed people to tested people.
topics.reason: The first prepositional phrase is echoed by the later lām phrase with the same noun.

topics.headline: human field contrast in Surah 17
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can relate divine encompassing here to a wider Surah 17 contrast with human withholding (17:100), while the local function remains bi-valency.
topics.reason: The row gives a concrete Surah 17 contrast at 17:100; it is useful as a boundary comparison but does not redefine the particle.

words.gloss_range: definite human collective as the first people-slot, encompassed by the Lord and prepared for later repetition
words.root_gloss_range: human sociability and familiarity, with a live derivational dispute toward forgetfulness; here a definite human collective
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلنَّاسِ}} ({{tr:al-nāsi}}) names the definite human collective under divine encompassing. The word can carry sociability and forgetfulness pressure, but locally it anchors the same people who will later be named as the target of trial.

topics.headline: definite human collective
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the object of encompassing as the recognizable human collective, not an unnamed subset.
topics.reason: The definite article and collective noun support a class-level human referent.

topics.headline: sociability and forgetfulness pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the human collective as socially gathered yet capable of forgetting divine encompassing; the local sense remains people.
topics.reason: The derivational dispute supplies pressure without replacing the selected human-collective sense.

topics.headline: first repeated human anchor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the same people from enclosure into trial through repeated wording and changed preposition.
topics.reason: The two people phrases bind the halves of the ayah while shifting grammatical role.

words.gloss_range: clause-linking connector that moves from quoted assurance into the explanatory trial clause
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) moves the discourse from quoted assurance into explanation. The connector keeps sequence while preventing the vision-and-tree clause from being swallowed into the earlier emphatic quotation.

topics.headline: transition from quote to explanation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah move from quoted assurance into divine explanation of the vision and tree as trial.
topics.reason: The connector separates the embedded quoted clause from the following explanatory making clause while maintaining sequence.

words.gloss_range: negative particle opening the first negation-exception restriction, excluding other purposes before trial is named
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) opens the first negation-exception frame, clearing away other purposes until trial is named. The same restriction logic links 17:60 with the sign-policy of 17:59 and with nearby Surah 17 making scenes around Quran response (17:45; 17:46).

topics.headline: first negation-exception opening
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees all competing purposes cleared before trial is named as the sole function.
topics.reason: The local mā is negative and opens the mā...illā restriction with jaʿalnā.

topics.headline: restriction frame across 17:59 and 17:60
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees divine withholding in 17:59 and divine trial-design in 17:60 sharing the same restriction logic.
topics.reason: The rows explicitly compare the mā...illā frames in 17:59 and 17:60.

topics.headline: Surah 17 making near Quran-response contexts
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can place this restriction beside Surah 17 making-clauses around Quran-response barriers and coverings (17:45; 17:46).
topics.reason: The inter row gives concrete Surah 17 references, and the comparison stays at pattern level.

words.gloss_range: completed divine rendering or assigning that makes the vision and tree function as trial
words.root_gloss_range: making, placing, rendering, assigning, and appointing; here deliberate rendering into a trial function
words.prose: {{ar:جَعَلْنَا}} ({{tr:ja'alnā}}) renders the vision and tree into a trial function, not merely into a topic adjacent to trial language. The perfect divine verb makes the design established, and the making-as-fitna formula has a parallel sorting use at 74:31. Within Surah 17, this making also belongs to the pattern where revelation-response scenes involve barriers, coverings, and trial.

topics.headline: rendering into trial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the vision is not merely near trial-language; it is grammatically rendered into a trial function.
topics.reason: The verb takes the vision as object and fitnatan as complement in the central making clause.

topics.headline: completed divine design
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees trial-design as a completed divine act before present warning begins.
topics.reason: The perfect verb and attached divine subject support established divine agency.

topics.headline: deliberate placing and rendering
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the vision and tree set into a designed function rather than accidentally becoming a test.
topics.reason: The root range of making, placing, appointing, and rendering supports intentional configuration.

topics.headline: fitna-design formula parallel
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes a Quranic design formula in which divine arrangement becomes a sorting trial (74:31).
topics.reason: The supplied row cites a concrete mā jaʿalnā...illā fitnatan parallel at 74:31.

topics.headline: Surah 17 revelation-response mechanism
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees making and placing as part of Surah 17’s mechanism for how revelation affects resistant hearers.
topics.reason: The row connects this making verb to nearby Quran-response contexts without contradicting local valency.

words.gloss_range: the specific divinely shown vision, objectified as a noun and made into a trial rather than a generic dream
words.root_gloss_range: seeing, perceiving, showing, and vision; here a specific divinely shown vision objectified as a trial

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: causative divine showing that defines the vision

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلرُّءْيَا}} ({{tr:ar-ru'yā}}) is the specific vision made into trial, defined by the relative clause as the one God showed the Prophet. It is not reduced to an ordinary dream; the rare vision word, its hamza variants, and its echo with {{ar:أَرَيْنَٰكَ}} ({{tr:araynāka}}) mark a precise seeing-event with public consequence (37:105; 48:27).

topics.headline: specific objectified vision
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees one specified vision objectified so it can be governed, qualified, and made trial.
topics.reason: Definiteness, case, relative qualification, and noun form all support the specific vision reading.

topics.headline: vision beyond ordinary dream
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the higher-status vision range in view, while the local clause defines it by divine showing rather than by a generic dream category.
topics.reason: The lexical distinction supports vision/veridical seeing pressure, but local grammar supplies the decisive specification.

topics.headline: hamza variants in the vision word
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a recitational pressure point where the same vision may be heard with a glottal catch or smoother flow.
topics.reason: The variants affect phonetic surface without changing the local referent.

topics.headline: rare Quranic vision cluster
topics.reader_payoff: The reader places this vision among rare Quranic vision passages where perception carries public consequence (37:105; 48:27).
topics.reason: The inter rows name concrete ruʾyā passages at 37:105 and 48:27.

topics.headline: vision defined by showing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the vision defined by divine showing and as a concrete instance of the prior sign-policy problem.
topics.reason: The noun and verb repeat the seeing root, and the boundary row ties the specific vision to 17:59 sign-policy.

words.gloss_range: feminine relative pronoun that binds the vision to the clause defining it as what God showed the Prophet
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّتِىٓ}} ({{tr:allatī}}) binds the vision to its qualifying clause. Its feminine agreement prevents the vision from remaining broad and makes the following divine showing define the head noun.

topics.headline: relative clause binds the vision
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the vision narrowed immediately by the clause that identifies it as what God showed the Prophet.
topics.reason: The feminine singular relative pronoun agrees with the vision and opens its qualifying clause.

words.gloss_range: causative divine showing: God makes the Prophet see, and the vision is defined by that act
words.root_gloss_range: seeing, perceiving, showing, and making visible; here Form IV causative showing by divine agency
words.prose: {{ar:أَرَيْنَٰكَ}} ({{tr:araynāka}}) makes God the causer of seeing and the Prophet the recipient of that perception. The repeated seeing root answers the vision noun: the vision is the thing God showed you, and that caused perception then enters the trial and warning economy.

topics.headline: causative showing with prophetic object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the Prophet is made to see by divine agency; he is not the source of the vision.
topics.reason: The Form IV perfect with -nā and -ka encodes divine causer and prophetic recipient.

topics.headline: perception as evidentiary channel
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the event as made-visible perception, stronger than a report passed along as information.
topics.reason: The perception semantics of causative seeing support a visible, revealed channel.

topics.headline: seeing within trial and warning economy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees caused perception feed into making-as-trial and then warning.
topics.reason: The cooccurrence row connects seeing, making, and warning fields locally.

topics.headline: showing answers the vision noun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the root echo: the vision is the thing God showed you.
topics.reason: The repeated r-ʾ-y root connects the noun and its defining verb.

words.gloss_range: exception particle closing the first restriction and leaving trial as the sole stated function

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: trial as the sole stated function after the exception

words.prose: {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}) closes the first restriction and turns negated purposes into one positive remainder. After this pivot, {{ar:فِتْنَةًۭ}} ({{tr:fitnatan}}) becomes the only stated function.

topics.headline: first exception pivot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader watches negated purposes turn into one positive remainder: trial for the people.
topics.reason: The exception particle completes the first mā...illā restriction and pivots to fitnatan.

words.gloss_range: indefinite diagnostic trial, selected by the restriction frame and carrying testing-under-pressure rather than mere disorder
words.root_gloss_range: testing, trying, assaying by fire, temptation, disorder, and affliction; here a diagnostic trial selected by local syntax
words.prose: {{ar:فِتْنَةًۭ}} ({{tr:fitnatan}}) is the indefinite complement into which the vision and tree are rendered. The root image of assaying by fire makes the trial diagnostic, a pressure that reveals response; variant evidence can make blind wandering explicit, while 74:31 and 17:59 keep the design-and-warning frame in view. Its tanwīn -an also begins a cadence later answered by transgression and greatness.

topics.headline: indefinite trial complement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees trial as the state into which the vision is rendered, with indefiniteness making it a trial-instance within a wider pattern.
topics.reason: The accusative indefinite verbal noun functions as the complement of jaʿalnā.

topics.headline: diagnostic smelting test
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels trial as assaying pressure that reveals composition, not merely punishment or social disorder.
topics.reason: The local construction selects diagnostic trial, while the root image gives that trial concrete heat and exposure.

topics.headline: variant makes wandering explicit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can see a variant apparatus pressure toward blind wandering inside the trial, while the standard text leaves that effect implicit.
topics.reason: The supplied variants add wandering language, but they do not replace the canonical local wording.

topics.headline: trial formula and warning link
topics.reader_payoff: The reader links this trial to a Quranic design formula (74:31) and to the warning purpose just stated in 17:59.
topics.reason: The rows give concrete parallels at 74:31 and the immediate 17:59 boundary.

topics.headline: indefinite cadence toward the close
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears trial begin an -an cadence later answered by transgression and greatness.
topics.reason: The cadence row names a local sound pattern connecting the middle and end of the ayah.

words.gloss_range: targeting lām that directs the trial toward the people while contrasting with the earlier address to the Prophet
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) targets the trial toward the people. Its repetition contrasts two roles in the same event: disclosure is to you, while the trial is for the people.

topics.headline: lām targets people with trial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that people are the affected field of trial, not owners of the vision or tree.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the people phrase and marks direction or target of effect.

topics.headline: two lām recipients distributed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the same preposition distribute two roles: disclosure to the Prophet and trial for the people.
topics.reason: The rows explicitly contrast laka with li-n-nāsi in the same ayah.

words.gloss_range: second definite people-slot, now governed by lām as the target of trial rather than by bi as encompassed object
words.root_gloss_range: human sociability and familiarity, with a live derivational dispute toward forgetfulness; here the same definite collective as trial target
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلنَّاسِ}} ({{tr:al-nāsi}}) returns as the second people-slot, now governed by lām as the target of fitna. The repeated noun and later -hum pronouns keep the same human domain moving from enclosure to testing to failed response.

topics.headline: second people-slot as target
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the same definite collective return, now as the target of trial.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive under lām and repeats the earlier people anchor.

topics.headline: social and forgetful people under trial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can feel the public trial exposing either social collectivity or forgetful failure, while the local referent remains people.
topics.reason: The derivational dispute is pressure on the human collective, not a replacement of the noun sense.

topics.headline: from encompassed to tested
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the resistant human domain from bi-governed enclosure into lām-governed trial and then into the later pronouns.
topics.reason: The repeated noun and later -hum pronouns preserve the same audience domain through changed roles.

words.gloss_range: coordinating connector that joins the tree to the vision inside the same fitna frame
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) coordinates the tree with the vision inside the same fitna frame. The connector pairs unlike media, a shown vision and a Quranic tree mention, without making the tree a separate topic.

topics.headline: vision and tree coordinated as trial instruments
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the tree and vision jointly governed by the fitna frame while remaining different kinds of testing media.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the tree with the vision as a co-object of jaʿalnā in the standard reading.

words.gloss_range: the definite cursed tree as coordinated trial-object; local syntax keeps it with the vision while root pressure suggests entanglement and dispute
words.root_gloss_range: tree, branching, entanglement, and dispute; here the concrete tree sense is selected while dispute-pressure survives as payoff
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلشَّجَرَةَ}} ({{tr:ash-shajarata}}) is kept by the standard accusative inside the trial frame with the vision, while the nominative variant shows how the parse could detach it. Its matching cursed adjective is locked to it by agreement, so the tree and curse-description arrive as one unit. The word remains a concrete tree, yet the sh-j-r pressure of entanglement helps explain why this Quran-located tree becomes a point of dispute, echoing earlier tree scenes (2:35; 7:19).

topics.headline: tree kept inside the trial frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees why the standard accusative matters: it keeps the tree coordinated with the vision as a trial-object, while the nominative variant shows an alternate parse.
topics.reason: The canonical accusative supports coordination; the nominative variant is useful contrast but does not govern the local parse.

topics.headline: tree controls cursed adjective
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the tree and its curse-description are locked together by agreement.
topics.reason: The head noun controls the following feminine definite accusative adjective.

topics.headline: tree and entanglement pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the cursed tree as both a concrete tree and a source of entangled dispute, while the selected local sense remains tree.
topics.reason: The sh-j-r evidence supports dispute-pressure, but local noun syntax selects the concrete tree.

topics.headline: one specified tree
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees one definite tree made a discrete trial instrument by coordination, curse, and Quran-location.
topics.reason: The unit noun and definite accusative form give the local tree a specified role.

topics.headline: earlier tree scenes echoed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears this tree against earlier tree scenes (2:35; 7:19), with the local tree functioning as Quran-located trial rather than garden prohibition.
topics.reason: The inter rows cite concrete earlier tree scenes at 2:35 and 7:19.

topics.headline: vision and tree as paired media
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees fitna operating through both a shown vision and a Quranic tree mention.
topics.reason: The row captures the syntactic pairing of semantically unlike objects.

words.gloss_range: definite passive participle describing the tree as curse-borne or mercy-excluded, not as an independent actor
words.root_gloss_range: curse, exclusion, and driving away from mercy or good; here expressed as a passive attribute borne by the tree
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمَلْعُونَةَ}} ({{tr:al-mal'ūnata}}) agrees with the tree as its identifying adjective and marks the tree as bearing curse-status. The passive participle makes the tree a recipient of exclusion from mercy; the following Quran-location can also be read as locating that curse-description in discourse. The same root can be applied to cursed people elsewhere (33:61).

topics.headline: cursed adjective attached to tree
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees cursed as an identifying attribute of the tree, reinforced by agreement and paired feminine cadence.
topics.reason: The adjective matches the tree in definiteness, gender, and accusative case.

topics.headline: tree bears curse-status
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the tree bears exclusion-from-mercy status; it does not perform the curse.
topics.reason: The passive participle and l-ʿ-n semantics support received curse or exclusion from favor.

topics.headline: curse-status may be Quran-located
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can see the curse-description as potentially located in Quranic discourse, while the adjective still modifies the tree.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence allows the following fī phrase to modify the participle without detaching it from the tree.

topics.headline: curse lexeme transferred to a tree
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a moral-exclusion term normally applied to people also attached to a tree, with a human parallel at 33:61.
topics.reason: The inter row compares this tree adjective with cursed people at 33:61.

words.gloss_range: locative preposition placing the tree or curse inside Quranic discourse, with live attachment ambiguity
words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) governs the Quran phrase and leaves a useful attachment ambiguity: the tree may be in the Quran, or its curse-status may be Quran-located. Either way, the trial arises from Quranic discourse, within Surah 17’s response chain of aversion, transgression, and loss (17:41; 17:82).

topics.headline: Quran-location attachment ambiguity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Quran-location may attach to the tree or to the cursed descriptor, giving two local reading routes without forcing one.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the Quran phrase, and attachment evidence allows both modification paths.

topics.headline: tree encountered in Quranic discourse
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the trial arising from a Quran-located object, not from a visible tree before the audience.
topics.reason: The prepositional phrase locates the relevant tree or curse in the Quranic text.

topics.headline: Quran-location inside increase-response chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader places this Quran-located trial inside Surah 17’s response chain of aversion, transgression, and loss (17:41; 17:82).
topics.reason: The supplied row links 17:41, 17:60, and 17:82 as a threefold increase-response pattern.

words.gloss_range: the recognized Quranic recitation/corpus as the textual location where the cursed tree is encountered
words.root_gloss_range: reciting, reading, and gathering; here the recognized gathered recitation or Quranic discourse as textual locus
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْقُرْءَانِ}} ({{tr:al-Qur'āni}}) is the definite textual locus where the tree is encountered. Its root pressure of reciting and gathering makes the phrase a gathered recitation environment, and its hamza can be smoothed in variant recitation without changing that locus. Surah 17’s Quran references show revelation producing divergent responses (17:41; 17:45; 17:46; 17:82).

topics.headline: Quran as textual location
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the recognized Quranic corpus as the place where the tree is encountered before the warning clause resumes.
topics.reason: The noun is definite and genitive under fī, closing the middle fitna beat.

topics.headline: gathered and recited discourse
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the tree inside a gathered recitation, not merely in abstract religious speech.
topics.reason: The q-r-ʾ evidence supports gathering and reciting as compatible pressures for the Quranic locus.

topics.headline: hamza smoothing in recitation noun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a recitational pressure point in the name of the recitation itself, while the meaning remains the Quranic locus.
topics.reason: The variant drops the hamza phonetically without changing the local referent.

topics.headline: Surah 17 Quran-response pattern
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees this Quran reference among Surah 17 scenes where revelation exposes aversion, barriers, coverings, transgression, and loss (17:41; 17:45; 17:46; 17:82).
topics.reason: The inter rows give concrete Surah 17 Quran-response references.

words.gloss_range: resumptive connector shifting from completed trial-design to ongoing warning and its paradoxical outcome
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) resumes after the completed trial-design and shifts into ongoing warning. The hinge leads directly into the ayah’s paradox: warning is given, yet the response increases in transgression.

topics.headline: shift from design to warning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the turn from completed trial-design into ongoing present warning and its paradoxical result.
topics.reason: The connector resumes or coordinates a new clause at the tense shift into nukhawwifuhum.

words.gloss_range: ongoing intensive divine warning or frightening directed at them, carrying both affective threat and protective warning force
words.root_gloss_range: fear, fearing, warning, threatening, and causing fear; here Form II intensive warning/frightening directed at them
words.prose: {{ar:نُخَوِّفُهُمْ}} ({{tr:nukhawwifuhum}}) is present, intensive warning directed at them. It enacts the warning purpose named in 17:59, keeps the divine We in the standard reading, contrasts with satanic fear-generation elsewhere (3:175), and sets up the same -hum group to become recipients of increase.

topics.headline: ongoing warning of the same recipients
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees present divine warning acting on the same people before they become recipients of increase.
topics.reason: The imperfect verb with attached -hum object opens the final warning-response beat.

topics.headline: intensive fear-causing as warning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels warning as repeated affective pressure meant to alter response, not as neutral notification.
topics.reason: The Form II verb and kh-w-f semantics support intensive frightening, threat, and warning.

topics.headline: variant shifts divine agent expression
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a variant can express the agent as He, while the standard reading keeps the divine We directly present.
topics.reason: The variant changes person but does not replace the canonical first-person plural surface.

topics.headline: divine warning versus satanic intimidation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the same fear-generation form contrasted by agent: Satan frightens in one setting (3:175), while here God warns.
topics.reason: The inter row cites the Form II contrast at 3:175.

topics.headline: 17:59 warning purpose enacted
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the prior purpose of warning in 17:59 become a present act in 17:60, exposing failed reception.
topics.reason: The root echo carries takhwīf from 17:59 into the active verb here.

topics.headline: warned become increased recipients
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the same -hum group from being warned to being increased in transgression.
topics.reason: The same object suffix appears in nukhawwifuhum and yazīduhum.

words.gloss_range: consecutive fa that makes the following increase clause the paradoxical result of warning
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) makes the next clause the consequence slot of the warning. The particle carries causal sequence, but the content is adversative: warning leads, in this described case, only to greater transgression.

topics.headline: consequence marker as paradox pivot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final clause as the immediate consequence slot of warning, made paradoxical by its content.
topics.reason: The particle links warning to outcome while the outcome reverses expected restraint.

words.gloss_range: negative particle opening the final restriction, clearing every outcome except increased transgression
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) opens the final restriction by negating every possible increase, including repentance, restraint, or benefit, before the exception. Together with the earlier restriction, it makes the ayah’s middle and end answer each other: only trial, then only transgression.

topics.headline: final negation-exception opening
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees every possible beneficial increase excluded before transgression is isolated.
topics.reason: The negative mā opens the second restriction before yazīduhum.

topics.headline: two restrictions close trial and outcome
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the middle and ending answer each other: only trial, then only transgression.
topics.reason: The repeated mā...illā frames create the ayah’s trial-outcome loop.

words.gloss_range: transitive increase applied to the same warned recipients, with transgression specifying what grows
words.root_gloss_range: increase, addition, growth, and amplification without fixed moral direction; here the object and specification make the increase negative

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: transgression as the specified content of the increase

words.prose: {{ar:يَزِيدُهُمْ}} ({{tr:yazīduhum}}) makes the warned group the recipients of increase, with {{ar:طُغْيَٰنًۭا}} ({{tr:ṭughyānan}}) naming what grows. The root is neutral amplification, capable of other outcomes such as humility (17:109), but here the object and specification make the increase negative and place it within Surah 17’s response scale (17:41; 17:82).

topics.headline: same recipients receive increase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the warned group as the same group grammatically receiving increased transgression.
topics.reason: The imperfect transitive verb carries the -hum object, and ṭughyānan specifies the increase.

topics.headline: neutral increase shaped by transgression
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that increase is morally neutral until the clause specifies transgression as what grows.
topics.reason: The root can amplify different states, including humility (17:109), but local object and specification make it negative here.

topics.headline: external subject increases them
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees increase happening to them through an external subject, not merely self-increase.
topics.reason: The chosen Form I transitive surface differs from derived self-increase patterns.

topics.headline: Surah 17 increase scale
topics.reader_payoff: The reader places this increase among Surah 17’s negative response scale: aversion, transgression, and loss (17:41; 17:82).
topics.reason: The rows connect z-y-d with the Quran-response and transgression fields in Surah 17.

words.gloss_range: exception particle that isolates transgression as the sole remainder after final negation
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}) closes the second restriction and leaves transgression as the sole semantic remainder. It mirrors the first exception so that only trial is paired with only transgression.

topics.headline: final exception isolates transgression
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees transgression left as the only positive remainder after negation.
topics.reason: The exception particle closes the second restriction and isolates ṭughyānan.

topics.headline: second exception mirrors the first
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees syntax pair only trial with only transgression.
topics.reason: The second illā mirrors the earlier exception before fitnatan.

words.gloss_range: indefinite verbal noun specifying the increase as boundary-overflowing transgression
words.root_gloss_range: overflowing, exceeding bounds, rebellion, and tyrannical overreach; here the increase is specified as moral boundary-overflow
words.prose: {{ar:طُغْيَٰنًۭا}} ({{tr:ṭughyānan}}) specifies the increase as boundary-overflowing transgression. Its root image of flood beyond limits, its pressure toward overreaching authority, and the revelation-response parallels (5:64; 5:68) make the final result a reversal of warning’s expected restraint from 17:59. Its -an cadence ties the close back to trial and greatness as the scene expands from private address to the resistant people.

topics.headline: transgression as measurable increase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees transgression not as a side label but as the named measurable content of the increase.
topics.reason: The indefinite verbal noun functions as the specification or object domain after yazīduhum.

topics.headline: boundary-overflow and overreach
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels transgression as overflow past limits, with pressure toward tyrannical overreach.
topics.reason: The t-gh-y evidence supports overflow and false-authority pressure compatible with local moral transgression.

topics.headline: increase-in-transgression formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees this clause inside a wider formula where revelation exposes and amplifies rebellion in deniers (5:64; 5:68).
topics.reason: The supplied inter rows name the same increase-in-transgression construction at 5:64 and 5:68.

topics.headline: warning answered by overflow
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees warning meant to restrain answered by boundary-overflow instead, linking back to the warning purpose in 17:59.
topics.reason: The rows explicitly contrast takhwīf in 17:59 with ṭughyān in 17:60.

topics.headline: cadence and boundary zoom
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears trial, overflow, and magnitude tied by cadence while the scene expands back from private address to the resistant people.
topics.reason: The sound and boundary rows add distinct closure and zoom payoffs.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative adjective scaling the transgression as great, with moral magnitude supplied by what it modifies
words.root_gloss_range: greatness, largeness, magnitude, significance, pride, and arrogance; here it scales transgression as a severe moral magnitude
words.prose: {{ar:كَبِيرًۭا}} ({{tr:kabīran}}) closes by scaling the transgression. The adjective is morally directed by the noun it modifies, can carry arrogance-pressure, echoes a severe-noun construction at 33:68, and reverses the opening containment image by ending with great overflow under divine encompassing. Its long ī plus tanwīn-alif gives the final moral verdict a lingering cadence.

topics.headline: great as dependent scale modifier
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah end not just with transgression but with transgression scaled by its final dependent adjective.
topics.reason: The adjective agrees with ṭughyānan in accusative indefiniteness and closes the ayah.

topics.headline: magnitude with arrogance pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the scale word takes its moral direction from transgression and can carry pride-swollen force here.
topics.reason: The k-b-r range is morally ambivalent, but local attachment to transgression fixes negative scale.

topics.headline: great severe-noun construction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can compare this great transgression to a great curse construction (33:68), while the local noun remains transgression.
topics.reason: The row cites the same adjective scaling a severe moral noun at 33:68.

topics.headline: Surah scale and containment reversal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the close reverse the opening image: people under divine encompassing still overflow into a scaled moral extreme, one of Surah 17’s large consequence terms (17:4; 17:9; 17:31).
topics.reason: The rows connect the ending scale to the opening encompassing and to Surah 17 scale markers.

topics.headline: heavy final cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final long cadence linger on the enlarged moral verdict.
topics.reason: The prosody row gives a distinct final-sound payoff.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Encompassed people turn disclosed images into assay material.** `ح و ط:B001/B004` surrounds and comprehends, `ر ء ي:B003/B012` dream-vision and making seen, `ف ت ن:B001` assays, `ش ج ر:B001/B009` tree and stock-origin, and `ط غ ي:B001/B002` rebels and overflows. Vision and tree are supplied inside comprehensive enclosure, but warning increases overflow. I infer the sign tests what orientation extracts from it. The ayah reads imagery as an assay whose reaction exposes the hearer.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 17:101–102 repeats seeing-sign, accusation, known insight, and ruin. The late Mosaic scene made the vision here part of a recurrent assay of whether disclosure becomes perception or overflow.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **The vision and tree as assay-media inside comprehensive enclosure.** Lexical evidence: `ح و ط B004` (complete grasp in knowledge or possession) in `أَحَاطَ`, `ف ت ن B001` (assaying by trial) in `فِتْنَةً`, `ش ج ر B002` (entangled dispute and speech) in `ٱلشَّجَرَةَ`, and `ط غ ي B002` (overflowing and overwhelming force) in `طُغْيَٰنًا`. Structural cue: 17:59 defines signs as warning and gives a visible sign that was wronged; here vision, tree, warning, increase, and overflow form a causal sequence, before 17:61–65 stages Iblis's challenge and bounded authority. Assigned role: enclosure secures the field, assay reveals what response contains, the tree becomes an entangled interpretive object, and repeated fear lets latent rebellion overflow visibly. Abductive move: warning-to-increase is explicit, but I infer that the increase reveals rather than escapes divine grasp. Reading change: the disputed images function diagnostically: they expose the tested population's disposition within an already comprehended field.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 17:61–65 completed the assay: Iblis's refusal, campaign, and sharply limited authority show what the trial reveals while correcting any deterministic reading of divine enclosure.

baseline.text: Bir zaman sana, Rabbin insanları kuşatmıştır, demiştik. Sana gösterdiğimiz görüntüyü ve Kur'an'da lanetlenen ağacı insanlar için yalnızca bir sınama yaptık. Onları korkutuyoruz, fakat bu onların büyük azgınlığından başka bir şeyi artırmıyor.

findings.text: Görüntü ve lanetli ağaç, Allah'ın kuşatıcı bilgisi içinde tepkiyi açığa çıkaran sınama araçlarıdır; uyarının azgınlığı artırması bu alanın dışına kaçışı değil, gizli yönelişin taşarak görünür olmasını anlatır.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Direct Quranic parallel: reiterated discourse yields increased nufur, clarifying the warning's receiver-dependent effect.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Adds a public invocatory setting for lanah, but does not specify the tree or the warning-response sequence.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Defines fitnah through contrasting conditions, supporting the vision and tree as instruments that disclose response.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Shows one appointed datum producing certainty and increased iman for some, question and disorder for others.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The immediate setting supplies the recorded judgment horizon around the following warning and signs.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Contributes an inescapable enclosure reading for muhit, though its immediate object is Jahannam.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Explicitly makes the zaqqum tree a fitnah for wrongdoers, directly specifying the tree clause.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Supplies the enduring lanah consequence, without identifying the Quranic tree.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Places shajarat al-zaqqum in the contrast that unfolds the tree named in 17:60.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Frames human social arrangement itself as fitnah and joins it to divine sight, broadening the testing scene.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Directly parallels Quranic disclosure that increases loss in wrongdoers rather than benefiting every receiver.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Qualifies fitnah's reach: it does not make every recipient alike susceptible.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: An instituted direction functions to distinguish following from reversal, closely matching a made sign as fitnah.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The immediate predecessor identifies signs as tahwif and recalls a sign met with wrongdoing.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Adds a collective continuity to tughyan, but no specific sign or testing mechanism.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Only a remote contrast between increase for muhsinun and the increase in tughyan at 17:60.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The witness-and-vindication scene adds little beyond the later outcome of rejection.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: A prohibited tree marks a boundary whose crossing makes wrongdoing visible; it remains a distinct tree scene.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: Shared jala and people language does not materially illuminate the focus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Provides the contrasting increase: Quranic reception can increase khushu rather than tughyan.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Adds the forceful overstepping sense of taghiyah, but not the focus's response pattern.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The commanded sajda and Iblis's refusal anticipate the immediately following narrative context.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The healing resonance is too remote from the focus's testing and increase pattern.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Directly supports the encompassing dimension of the declaration about people.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Revelation itself can increase tughyan and kufr in many recipients, closely matching the final clause.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: A command to sajda produces increased nufur, a close parallel to warning intensifying resistance.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Supplies a knowledge-encompassing reading for ahatna, with human power remaining inside that scope.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Preserves the social reading in which a community's condition becomes fitnah for oppressors.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Connects lanah with a settled punitive outcome, but remains secondary to the tree clause.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Its disciplined basar offers only a distant contrast to the shown ru'ya.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Confirms that ru'ya can be ratified and acted upon, without explaining its fitnah function.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Adds expulsion to the lanah branch associated with rebellion.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Presents tughyan as a collective condition recognized after its consequences.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Its enclosing fire provides a concrete consequence-side parallel to the encompassing declaration.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Adds the contrary trajectory: a settled interior receives an increase in iman.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The tree is a setting for pledge, not an explanation of the cursed-tree phrase.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Reiterates Iblis's refusal to the sajda command in the surrounding narrative complex.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Names tughyan as the decisive human crossing of bounds and connects it to its consequence.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Adds the destination of taghin, but little about how warning becomes increase.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Shows tughyan and kufr as a feared harmful trajectory, not merely an abstract label.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Makes Pharaoh's tughyan a tyrannical authority pattern, extending the focus's large tughyan.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Directly contrasts premature denial with knowledge that has not encompassed the signs.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The statement of favor does not add to the testing, tree, or response dynamics.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The expectation about resurrection is only indirectly related through the escape channel.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Preserves fitnah as a possible misleading proof for deniers, a secondary social dimension.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Offers Quranic reception as khushu and reflection, a useful contrast to resistant increase.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Reinforces that no movement or flight escapes divine reach.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Adds a delayed, self-deepening form of tughyan rather than a corrective response.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Again joins revealed material, increased tughyan and kufr, and lanah; it reinforces multiple focus terms.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A sign does not compel a neutral observer; it enters a preexisting disposition and makes acceptance, denial, fear, or overflow visible.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Warning is less a coercive spectacle than an assay: inscription fixes the outcome, visible evidence tests the receiver, and the receiver's reaction can amplify the very excess being warned against.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Encompassing Vision as Assay and Amplifier
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An encompassing field contains the audience while a shown vision and an entangled tree test it; warning then increases either caution or overflowing resistance.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: sensory and cognitive enclosure (`quranic:root_000372:B001/m01`); complete encompassing knowledge (`quranic:root_000372:B004/m01`); dream-vision (`quranic:root_000531:B003/m01`); showing and disclosure (`quranic:root_000531:B012/m01`); assay of metal and person (`quranic:root_001128:B001/m01`); rooted tree (`quranic:root_000777:B001/m01`); entangled contention (`quranic:root_000777:B002/m01`); expulsion under curse (`quranic:root_001359:B001/m01`); induced fear (`quranic:root_000447:B002/m01`); increase (`quranic:root_000657:B001/m01`); overflow beyond limit (`quranic:root_000937:B001/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The audience is already inside an encompassing field, so the vision is not needed to overcome divine distance. It functions as an assay. The tree's entanglement materializes contested interpretation, and warning becomes an amplifier that reveals whether the tested material tempers or overflows.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, önceki bir eşten olan çocuk ile o çocuğun bakımını üstlenen yeni eş arasındaki karşılıklı aile bağını destekler. Aynı dişil biçimin bakıcı kadın ve evde süt için beslenen hayvan anlamları da bulunduğundan bağlam ayrımı zorunludur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Üvey çocuk, üvey ebeveyn ve bakıcı anlamları karşılıklı bakım ilişkisine bağlıdır; genel yetiştirme anlamıyla karıştırılmamalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız tanıklanan aile ve bakım rolleriyle sınırlıdır; genel bakım veya yetiştirme eylemi bu kişi adlarına taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Önceki bir eşten olan çocuk ile o çocuğun bakımını üstlenen yeni eş arasında kurulan üvey aile ve yetiştirme ilişkisidir. Bazı kullanımlarda bakıcı kadın ya da evde beslenen dişi hayvan da aynı bakım bağıyla adlandırılır.

facets.statement: Çocuk ve yeni eş, biyolojik olmayan fakat bakım üstlenilen aile ilişkisiyle birbirine bağlanır.
Bakıcı kadın ve evde sütü için beslenen dişi hayvan, bakım ilişkisine dayanan genişlemiş kullanımlardır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar üvey oğul ve kız ile annenin eşi veya babanın eşini karşılıklı bakım ilişkisi içinde açıklar; bakıcı kadın anlamını da bu çerçeveye ekler.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, koyulaşmış meyve özü veya yağ tortusu olan bir maddeyi ve bu maddeyle deri kap, yiyecek ya da ilacın işlenip güçlendirilmesini tutarlı biçimde bir araya getirir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Maddenin kendisi ile o madde kullanılarak işlenmiş nesne ayrıdır; sahiplik ve yönetim anlamları bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım doğrudan koyu öz veya tortu ile onun kullanıldığı işleme alanında kalır; benzer sesli sahiplik anlamına genişlemez.

facets.statement: Temel madde koyu bir meyve özü veya yağın dibinde kalan koyu tortudur.
Deri, kap, yiyecek ve ilaç bu maddeyle işlenir, sağlamlaştırılır veya hazırlanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar koyu öz ve yağ tortusu anlamını, deri kapların güçlendirilmesi ile yiyecek ve ilaçların bu maddeyle hazırlanması kullanımına bağlar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, bir yere bağlanıp oradan ayrılmama çekirdeğini insan, deve ve bulut için destekler; süreklilik ve yaklaşma anlamları da kalıcılık eksenine bağlı yan gelişmelerdir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Temel sınır bir yerde kalma ve sürmedir; hareketin kendisi veya bulutun türü bu dalın çekirdeği değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yer, hayvan ve bulutla kurulan bağlı kullanımlar ayrı örnekler olarak korunur; bunlardan biri bütün dalın tek yalın anlamı yapılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir yerde kalıp oradan ayrılmamak veya bir durumun kesilmeden sürmesidir. Hayvanın bir eşe bağlanması ve bir şeye yaklaşma anlamı bu kalıcılık çekirdeğinin özel uzantılarıdır.

facets.statement: Kişi, hayvan veya başka bir varlık bulunduğu yere bağlanır ve oradan ayrılmaz.
Bulutun ya da rüzgârın sürmesi, kalıcılığın zamansal genişlemesidir.
Hayvanın eşe bağlanması ve bir şeye yaklaşma, çekirdeğe bağlı özel kullanımlardır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar yerde kalma, hayvanın belli yere veya eşe bağlanması, bulut ile rüzgârın sürmesi ve yaklaşmayı kalıcılık çevresinde toplar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, birbirine binmiş ya da aşağıda asılı duran bir bulut kümesini ortak kimlik olarak destekler. Beyazlık bazı tanıklıklarda belirtilse de başka tanıklıklar siyah olabileceğini söylediğinden renk tanımın zorunlu öğesi değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal bulutun yapısını ve konumunu anlatır; renk ile yağmur veya bitki yetiştirme sonucu zorunlu tanım öğesi değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım doğrudan bulut kümesi anlamıyla sınırlıdır; yağmurun kendisi veya yalnız yağış zamanı bu yalın anlama taşınmaz.

Bitkiyi besleyen yağmurla ilişkilendirilmesi adlandırmanın açıklaması olarak verilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, kura veya kumar oklarını bir arada tutan deri parçası, bez ya da okluk benzeri kabı tutarlı biçimde gösterir. Okların topluca kendisi de kabın bir araya getirme işlevinden doğan yakın kullanımdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal tek bir ok veya kura çubuğunu değil, bunları bir arada tutan kap ya da topluluğu anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız ok ve kura çubuklarını toplayan kap ile toplu oklar anlamında kalır; tek tek ok adlarına genişlemez.

concept_map.definition: Kura veya kumarda kullanılan ok ve çubukları bir arada tutan deri ya da bez kap; buna bağlı olarak kabın içindeki okların topluluğudur.

facets.statement: Deri veya bezden yapılan kap, kura oklarını ve çubuklarını bir arada tutar.
Kabın içindeki okların topluluğu, kapsayan nesneden kapsanana geçen kullanımdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar deri parçası, bez veya okluğa benzer kap anlatımında birleşir ve kura oklarının topluluğunu bununla bağlantılı olarak verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kura veya kumar oklarının konduğu deri ya da bez kabı anlatan temel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Kap olma, okları toplama ve kura bağlamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kabın kendisinden çok içinde bir araya getirilmiş okların bütünü kastedildiğinde uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Okların tek tek değil toplu hâlde bulunması yönünü korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: kura oklarını bir arada tutan deri veya bez kap

error_profile.preserves: Okları içinde toplama ve taşıma işlevini korur.
error_profile.adds: Savaş ve av oklarına özgü genel taşıma kabı anlamını ekler.
error_profile.collision: Kura ve kumar bağlamındaki özel kap ile sıradan ok kabını karıştırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kura çubuklarını bir arada tutan kap ve onların toplu hâli odak dala özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Uç ve tüy takılmamış tek ok gövdesi ya da tek kura çubuğu komşu dalın çekirdeğidir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da kura veya kumarda kullanılan ok biçimli çubuklarla ilgilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal çubukları toplayan kap veya takım düzeyindedir; komşu dal ise tek bir çubuğun kendisini adlandırır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; kap ile içindeki tek çubuk arasındaki temel ayrımı gösteren aday seçildi, belirli sıra okları ve oyunun bütünü tekrara yol açmamak için alınmadı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الربابة للجلدة أو الوعاء الذي تجمع فيه القداح أو سهام الميسر، وجماعة السهام نفسها
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليست الربابة العهد، ولا الرباب السحاب
branches.source_phrase_ar: الربابة: قطعة من أدم تجمع فيها القداح (jamhara); الربابة شبيهة بالكنانة تجمع فيها سهام الميسر؛ جماعة السهام (sihah); الربابة: جماعة السهام؛ الجلدة التي تجمع فيها السهام (tahdhib); لما يجمع فيه القدح ربابة (mufradat); الخرقة التي يجعل فيها القداح ربابة (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, tarafları birbirine bağlayan sözleşme, güvence ve bağlılık düzenini ortak çekirdek olarak destekler. Vergi veya onda bir pay anlamı, alındığında bağlayıcı söz gibi işlemesiyle açıklanan ikincil bir uzantıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Ana anlam karşılıklı bağlılık doğuran söz ve güvencedir; vergi payı ancak bu bağlayıcılığa dayanan özel kullanımdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım doğrudan sözleşme, güvence ve ona bağlı insanlar alanında kalır; aynı biçimdeki kap veya bulut anlamları dışarıda tutulur.

concept_map.definition: İnsanları karşılıklı bağlılık, güvence veya dayanışma içinde birleştiren sözleşme ve verilmiş sözdür. Bu sözleşmeye bağlı kişiler ile söz gibi bağlayıcı sayılan vergi payı da ilişkili kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Karşılıklı söz ve güvence, taraflar arasında bağlayıcı bir ilişki kurar.
Sözleşmeye bağlı kişiler bu bağın tarafları olarak topluca adlandırılır.
Vergi veya onda bir pay, bağlayıcı söz gibi işlediği açıklamasıyla aynı alana genişler.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar sözleşme, verilmiş söz, güvence ve ona bağlı kişileri ortak bir bağlayıcılık altında toplar; vergi payını açıklamalı bir uzantı olarak ekler.

concept_gloss.applicability: Tarafları karşılıklı bağlılık ve koruma ilişkisine sokan sözleşme için genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Söz verme, bağlayıcılık, güvence ve tarafları birleştirme öğelerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Verilmiş söz veya güvence düzeninin tarafları topluca kastedildiğinde uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Kişilerin aynı bağlayıcı söz çevresinde birleşmesini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Vergi veya onda bir payın sözleşmeye benzer bağlayıcılıkla adlandırıldığı özel kullanım içindir.

error_profile.preserves: Vergi payı ile bağlayıcı söz arasındaki açıklanmış ilişkiyi korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: tarafları birleştiren bağlayıcı söz veya sözleşme
bağlayıcı söz; söz gibi bağlayıcı vergi payı

error_profile.preserves: Taraflar arasında bağlayıcı söz kurulması yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Güvence, bağlı kişiler ve vergi payına uzanan kullanım alanını kaybeder.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Sözleşmeye bağlı kişilerin toplu adı ve vergi payına yapılan uzantı odak dalda bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yemin, güvenli geçiş, korunan hak alanı ve söz veren kişinin nitelenmesi komşu dalda daha geniştir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da verilmiş söz, sözleşme, güvence ve bu güvenceye bağlı taraflar alanında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal insanları bir araya getiren bağ ve onun taraflarını öne çıkarır; komşu dal sözün korunması, yemin ve güvenlik sonuçlarını daha geniş kapsar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; sözleşme ve güvence çekirdeğini en yakın paylaşan aday seçildi, sözün kurulması, bozulması veya yalnız vekâlet alanındaki adaylar dışarıda bırakıldı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الربابة والرباب للعهد والميثاق والجوار، والأربة للمعاهدين، والرباب للعشور إذا جعل كالعهد

branches.source_phrase_ar: الربابة: العهد والمعاهدون أربة (jamhara); الربابة: العهد والميثاق؛ الأربة أهل الميثاق (sihah); الرباب: العهد؛ الرباب: العشور (tahdhib); العقد في موالاة الغير: الربابة (mufradat); الربابة وهو العهد؛ للمعاهدين أربة؛ الرباب العشور (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt belirli bir bitki ya da birkaç bitki için kullanılan adı destekler, ancak bunun ağaç, genel bitki veya yumuşak ot oluşunda tanıklıklar aynı ayrıntıyı vermez. Yazın kurumadan yeşil kalma yalnız bazı tanıklıklarda belirtilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal genel olarak bütün yeşil bitkileri değil, adı bu biçimde verilen bir veya birkaç belirli bitki türünü kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım doğrudan tanıklanan bitki adıyla sınırlıdır; genel otluk, ağaçlık veya bütün yaz yeşil kalan bitkiler anlamına genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Yumuşak ot, başka bir bitki veya küçük ağaç olarak betimlenen belirli bir bitki adıdır; bazı türlerinin yazın kurumadan yeşil kaldığı belirtilir.

facets.statement: Ad, genel bitki sınıfını değil belirli bir bitki ya da bitki grubunu gösterir.
Bitkinin ot, başka bir bitki veya ağaç sayılması tanıklıklara göre değişir.
Yumuşaklık ve yazın kurumadan yeşil kalma bazı tanımlarda ayırt edici özelliktir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar bunun belirli bir bitki adı olduğunda birleşir; ot, ağaç ve yumuşak yazlık yeşil bitki betimleri arasında kapsam farkı bırakır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Türün tam bitkibilimsel karşılığı belirlenmeden, kanıttaki özel bitki adını açıklamak için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Özel bitki adı oluşunu ve tür ayrıntısındaki belirsizliği korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yumuşak bir ot ve yazın kurumayan bitki olarak betimlenen özel tanıklık için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yumuşaklık ve yaz boyunca yeşil kalma özelliklerini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: belirli bir bitki, yumuşak ot veya küçük ağaç türü

error_profile.preserves: Bitki ve yumuşak yeşillik yönünü kısmen korur.
error_profile.adds: Bütün otsu bitkileri kapsayan geniş ve türsüz bir anlam ekler.
error_profile.collision: Ağaç olarak verilen tanıklığı ve özel tür adını görünmez kılar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Belirli bir bitki adı olma ve bazı türlerinin yazın kurumadan kalması odak dala özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Ağaç olmayan bütün taze yeşil otları kapsayan genel sınıf komşu dalın alanıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da yumuşak ve yeşil otsu bitkileri gösterebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal özel ve türü tam belirlenmemiş bir bitki adıdır; komşu dal ise ağaç olmayan taze yeşil bitkilerin genel sınıfını anlatır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; özel bitki adı ile genel yeşil ot sınıfı arasındaki sınırı gösteren aday seçildi, yalnız başka özel bitki adları karşılaştırma değeri düşük olduğu için alınmadı.

branches.source_phrase_ar: الربة: ضرب من الشجر أو النبت (jamhara); الربة بالكسر: ضرب من النبت، والجمع الربب (sihah); الربة: بقلة ناعمة؛ اسم لعدة من النبات لا تهيج في الصيف (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, temel olarak bol miktarda suyu ve bu adın suyun toplanmasıyla açıklanmasını destekler. Suyun tatlı olması mümkün bir nitelik olarak verilir, fakat bütün kullanımlar için zorunlu değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Miktar çokluğu çekirdektir; tatlılık isteğe bağlı bir nitelik, havuz veya su yatağı ise bu dalın anlamı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım doğrudan bol su anlamıyla sınırlıdır; suyu tutan yer, kuyu veya deniz gibi kap ve yer adları yalın anlama eklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir yerde toplanmış ya da çok miktarda bulunan sudur; bazı kullanımlarda tatlı su olduğu ayrıca belirtilir.

facets.statement: Belirleyici özellik suyun çok miktarda bulunması ve toplanmış olmasıdır.
Tatlılık bazı tanıklıklarda olası bir niteliktir, ancak çekirdeğin zorunlu koşulu değildir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar çok miktardaki su anlamında birleşir ve adlandırmayı suyun toplanmasına bağlar; tatlı su niteliğini zorunlu olmayan bir seçenek olarak verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Suyun bulunduğu yerden çok miktarının ve birikmiş oluşunun anlatıldığı bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Su, miktar çokluğu ve toplanma özelliklerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Tanıklığın suyun hem çok hem tatlı olduğunu açıkça belirttiği kullanımda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Miktar çokluğu ile belirtilmiş tatlılık niteliğini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: çok miktarda su; bazen bol tatlı su

error_profile.preserves: Suyun bir yerde toplanmış olması yönünü korur.
error_profile.adds: Belirli bir doğal su kütlesi ve yer biçimi anlamını ekler.
error_profile.collision: Miktar bildiren su adıyla suyun bulunduğu coğrafi yeri karıştırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Tatlı su olasılığı ve yalnız miktarı adlandırma odak dalda öne çıkar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Deniz, büyük nehir ve küçük ya da büyük göl gibi belirli su kütlesi türleri komşu dalda bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da geniş veya çok miktarda suyu gösterebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal suyun miktarını ve toplanmasını adlandırır; komşu dal ise büyük su kütlelerini ve onların coğrafi türlerini daha geniş biçimde kapsar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; bol su ile belirli su kütlesi arasındaki sınırı gösteren aday seçildi, yalnız su yatağı, kuyu, kalıntı veya akış bildirenler yayımlanmadı.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, çekirdek olarak yaban sığırı sürüsünü destekler. Bazı tanıklıklar kapsamı genel sığır topluluğuna ve develere genişlettiği için hayvan türü bütün kullanımlarda aynı değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Sürü hâlinde bulunma zorunludur; tek hayvan anlamı yoktur ve deve kapsamı çekirdeğe değil genişlemiş kullanıma aittir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım doğrudan hayvan sürüsü adıyla sınırlıdır; insan topluluğu veya tek sığır ve deve anlamı bu dala aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Özellikle yaban sığırlarından oluşan sürüdür; bazı kullanımlarda genel sığır topluluğunu veya deve sürüsünü de kapsar.

facets.statement: Çekirdek kullanım yaban sığırlarının oluşturduğu sürüyü gösterir.
Genel sığır topluluğu ve deve sürüsü bazı tanıklıklarda kapsam genişlemesidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar yaban sığırı sürüsünde birleşir; bir tanıklık kapsamı genel sığır topluluğu ile deve sürüsüne kadar genişletir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Hayvanların tek tek değil sürü hâlinde ve özellikle yaban sığırı olarak anıldığı temel bağlamda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yaban sığırı ve sürü olma çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kapsamın yaban sığırından genel sığıra veya develere genişletildiği özel tanıklıkta uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Hayvan türündeki genişlemeyi ve sürü olma koşulunu korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: yaban sığırı sürüsü; bazen sığır veya deve topluluğu

error_profile.preserves: Hayvanların toplu hâlde bulunması yönünü korur.
error_profile.adds: Her türlü evcil veya yabani hayvan topluluğunu kapsayan sınırsız bir alan ekler.
error_profile.collision: Yaban sığırı çekirdeğini ve sınırlı deve genişlemesini belirsizleştirir.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Sürünün oluşmasını anlatan eylem ve başka yabani hayvan toplulukları komşu dalda yer alır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalın çekirdeği yaban sığırlarından oluşan sürüyü adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Ad olarak yaban sığırı sürüsünde çok yakındırlar; odak dal tür kapsamını sığır ve deveye genişletebilirken komşu dal sürüleşme eylemini de kapsar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; aynı yaban sığırı sürüsü çekirdeğini paylaşan aday seçildi, yalnız deve, tek hayvan veya genel sığır alanını paylaşanlar dışarıda bırakıldı.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, belirsiz bir adla azlık bildiren ilgeci ve ona eklenen öğelerle oluşan biçimleri tutarlı biçimde tek bir dil bilgisel dalda toplar. Ekleme, sonrasında ad veya eylem gelme koşulunu değiştirir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal bir varlığı adlandırmaz; azlık veya ara sıra gerçekleşme bildiren dil bilgisel işlev ve onun biçim değişkeleridir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız tanıklanan ilgeç ve ekli biçimlerinin söz dizimsel işleviyle sınırlıdır; aynı sesli ad anlamlarına genişlemez.

concept_map.definition: Belirsiz bir adla birlikte sayının azlığını bildiren bir ilgeçtir. Eklenen öğelere göre ardından eylem gelebilir ve anlam ara sıra gerçekleşmeye yaklaşabilir.

facets.statement: Temel biçim belirsiz adın önünde azlık bildirir ve adı dil bilgisel olarak kendine bağlar.
Eklenen bir öğe, ardından eylem gelmesini ve zaman zaman gerçekleşme yorumunu mümkün kılar.
Bazı ağız biçimlerinde sona farklı sesler eklenir, ancak temel azlık işlevi sürer.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar temel biçimin azlık bildiren ve belirsiz adı yöneten bir ilgeç olduğunda birleşir; ekli biçimlerin eylemle kullanımını ve ağız değişkelerini açıklar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Belirsiz bir adın sayıca az örneğini bildiren temel dil bilgisel kullanım için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: İlgeç olma, belirsiz adı yönetme ve azlık bildirme işlevlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Belirsiz bir adın önünde, o türden az sayıda örnek bulunduğunu anlatan çeviri bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Belirsiz örnekler arasındaki sayısal azlık anlamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ekli biçimin ardından eylem geldiği ve olayın ara sıra gerçekleştiği bağlamda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Eylemin zaman zaman gerçekleşmesi yorumunu korur.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bazı biçimlerinde eylemin önünde bulunabilen dil bilgisel bir öğeyi anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın temel işlevi azlık ve belirsiz ad yönetimidir; komşu dal ise doğrudan eyleme bağlanarak zaman, beklenti ve olasılık yorumları üretir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, aynı yalın sözlük biçimi için gereksinim, sıkı düğüm ve iyilikte bulunma anlamlarını açıkça sıralar. Dal bu anlamları tek bir kavrama indirgemeden çok anlamlı bir sözlük kümesi olarak koruduğunda kaynak kaydıyla uyumludur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Üç anlam bağlama göre birbirinin alternatifi olarak okunmalıdır; kaynak aralarında ortak bir kavramsal veya kökensel bağ açıklamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanıklanan yalın biçim üç ayrı sözlük anlamı taşır; tanım bunları tek anlamda birleştirmeden aynı biçimin çok anlamlı kullanımları olarak verir.

concept_map.definition: Aynı yalın sözlük biçimi, aralarında ortak bir kavramsal bağ belirtilmeksizin, bağlama göre gereksinim, sıkı düğüm ya da iyilik ve yardım anlamlarından birini taşır.

facets.statement: Kayıt, aynı biçim altında birbirine indirgenmeyen üç alternatif sözlük anlamını bir arada tanıklar.
Bir kullanımda biçim, karşılanması beklenen bir gereksinimi bildirir.
Başka bir kullanımda çözülmesi güç, sıkıca bağlanmış düğümü bildirir.
Bir diğer kullanımda başkasına sağlanan iyilik ve yardımı bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek kaynak kaydı aynı biçimi gereksinim, sıkı düğüm ve iyilikte bulunma anlamlarıyla tanıklar; anlamlar arasında ortak bir açıklama vermediği için bunlar ayrı sözlük kullanımları olarak korunur.

concept_gloss.applicability: Aynı biçimin üç ayrı sözlük anlamını birlikte gösteren kavramsal özet olarak uygundur; tekil bağlamda ilgili anlam seçilmelidir.

error_profile.preserves: Üç ayrı anlamı ortak bir çekirdek varmış gibi birleştirmeden korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin başka birinden karşılanmasını beklediği gereksinimi bildiren kullanım içindir.

error_profile.preserves: Karşılanması beklenen gereksinim anlamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir bağın çözülmesi güç biçimde sıkıca düğümlendiği tekil kullanım içindir.

error_profile.preserves: Düğümün sıkı ve sağlam bağlanmış olmasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir başkasına yarar sağlama veya iyilikte bulunma anlamındaki tekil kullanım içindir.

error_profile.preserves: Başkasına sağlanan iyilik ve yarar anlamını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal sıkı düğümü yalnızca aynı biçimin üç alternatif sözlük anlamından biri olarak tanıklar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal düğüm ve sağlam bağlama alanından güçlük, sertlik, aykırılık ve başka bağlı kullanımlara genişler.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da çözülmesi güç, sağlam bağlanmış düğüm anlamında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Örtüşme yalnız düğüm anlamındadır; odak dalın kaydı ayrıca gereksinim ve iyilik anlamlarını taşırken komşu dal bağlama ve sertlik çevresinde daha geniş bir anlam alanı kurar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal iyiliği aynı biçimin gereksinim ve sıkı düğüm anlamları yanındaki alternatif kullanımı olarak tanıklar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal başkasına sunulan iyiliği bağış, karşılıksız verme ve el aracılığıyla anlatılan yardım çerçevesinde işler.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir başkasına iyilikte bulunma ve yarar sağlama alanında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalda iyilik, çok anlamlı bir sözlük biçiminin anlamlarından yalnız biridir; komşu dal ise verilen iyilik ve bağış ilişkisini kendi başına merkezleştirir.
